question: Which of the following authors has written the famous novel ‘Gulliver’s Travels’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jonathan Swift**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulliver’s Travels is regarded as Swift’s masterpiece**.
 
• It is a novel in four parts recounting Gulliver’s four voyages to fictional exotic lands.
 
• His travels are first among diminutive people–the Lilliputians, then among enormous giants–people of Brobdingnag, then among idealists and dreamers, and finally among horses.
 
• Each book has a different theme, but their common trait is to deflate human nature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Jonathan Swift was a famous 18th century satirist, essayist, political pamphleteer. 
 
• He adopted different pen names for publishing his works, such as Lemuel Gulliver, Isaac Bickerstaff, and M. B. Drapier.
 
• His satire followed Horatian and Juvenalian style.
 
• His notable works are :
 
 
• * *A Modest Proposal
 
• A Tale of a Tub
 
• Drapier's Letters
 
• A Modest Proposal
